title: An Ab initio Framework for Simulating Ultrafast Nonlinear Cavity Quantum Electrodynamics Spectra
summary: In this letter we introduce a theoretical framework for the simulation of ultrafast transient absorption pump-probe spectra of molecular polaritons. We derive and implement the cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) evolution equations of polaritonic states within the framework of the quasi-classical doorway-Window pproximation, hereto referred cQUEDA /sikeda/. This framework uses outputs from mixed quantum-classical dynamics simulations in the absence of the cavity.
